name: Jais-ASR

lineage.how_derived: speech-LLM: Whisper-style audio encoder (32 layers, d_model 1280) plus Jais-3-4B decoder (card says 'based on Jais-3-4B')

purpose: Arabic speech recognition as it is spoken: MSA and dialects of 19 countries with code-switching into English, French, Spanish, Italian, optional diacritization, built-in language/dialect ID and an explicit no-speech signal (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag and text)
license.notes: Card says weights are released under Apache 2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo (404). Text not read.

architecture.kind: speech LLM: audio encoder (32 layers, 20 heads) + Jais-3-4B decoder, custom code (JaisASRForConditionalGeneration)

variants.notes: card: bf16 weights 11.4 GB; quantized versions in the IFM Jais Speech collection (not opened)

pc-12gb.notes: 11.5 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (13.6 GB)

pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 11.5 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 11.5 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 11.5 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

other: vLLM plugin shipped in the repo, OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions

benchmarks.name: Open Universal Arabic ASR Leaderboard, average WER / CER over 6 test sets
benchmarks.harness: leaderboard protocol; card says lowest of all compared models incl. Speechmatics Melia 1, ElevenLabs Scribe v2, omniASR-LLM-7B, Qwen3-ASR-1.7B

strengths: refuses to invent text when there is no speech (card claim)
soft.maturity: 11.7k downloads in 6 weeks; large lab (IFM / MBZUAI family).

tona_fit.reason: Strong Arabic specialist but irrelevant for German-first users; keep as the Arabic option should a multilingual profile need it. The 5.7B-class speech LLM (11.5 GB bf16) fits 16 GB cards only with the model swapped in on demand.

sources.note: leaderboard named by the card; not opened

open_questions: Parameter total (about 5.7B) is my sum of 4B decoder plus audio tower from the card text; not verified in config
Leaderboard itself not opened, so the ranking is a vendor claim
